createProduct_7aa14a7887.description:
Successfully compiled but failed at runtime.

Error Analysis:
* What Failed: Mockito misuse and strictness violations in tests
* Where: MarketControllerCreateProductTest.java: createProductPropagatesExceptionWhenLogSaveFails (line 456), createProductPropagatesExceptionWhenProductSaveFails (line 442)
* Why: doNothing() used on a non-void method (likely save()); plus unused/unevaluated stubbings under strict mode
* Investigate: Replace doNothing with when(...).thenThrow/thenReturn for non-void methods; use doThrow for voids; remove or mark lenient any unused stubs; ensure argument matchers align so stubs are hit and that the test actually invokes the mocked methods,
scenarios: Successful creation returns the expected success message and performs saves
ProductRepository.save is invoked once with a ProductModel reflecting all inputs
LogRepository.save is invoked once with the expected route, entity, and timestamp
Operations occur in correct order: product is saved before log is saved
Zero price is accepted and still results in save and log
Negative price is accepted and still results in save and log
Extremely large price (Double.MAX_VALUE) is passed through
NaN price is forwarded (controller-level) and still attempts save and log
Negative musicId is accepted and still saved
Zero userId is accepted and forwarded
Empty description string is preserved and does not block save
Empty listProduct string is preserved and does not block save
Special characters and Unicode are preserved
Whitespace-only description is kept as-is
If ProductRepository.save throws, the exception propagates and Log.save is not called
If Log.save throws, the exception propagates after product save
The timestamp used in the log equals the value from Date.getTimeNow
Returned message is exactly "Produto Criado" with correct casing and spacing
No unexpected repository interactions occur during creation
Log route string remains literal "product/create/{userid}" and does not interpolate userId
Returns all products when the repository contains multiple items

deleteProduct_2e765309a5.description:
Successfully compiled but failed at runtime.

Error Analysis:
What Failed: DELETE /product/delete/5 returned 403, expected 200
Where: MarketControllerDeleteProductTest.deleteEndpointWithValidNumericIdReturns200AndMessage:102
Why: CSRF rejected the request; token present in session but not sent with the DELETE
Investigate: In test add .with(csrf()) and @WithMockUser (or mock user) or disable CSRF for this path; ensure security permits DELETE,
scenarios: Successful deletion with a valid positive id
Repository throws when the id does not exist
Negative id input
Zero id input where repository accepts the value
Very large id value
Repository interaction happens exactly once
No logging occurs during deletion
HTTP DELETE mapping returns success and body when id is numeric
HTTP DELETE with non-numeric id results in client error
Repeated deletion attempts for the same id
Missing repository injection leads to NullPointerException
Exact success message verification
No dependence on LogModel Date state
